intent.proves: A demo persona signs in through the storefront and is served a page as that user.
intent.scope: one persona per declared login type

bindings.reason: dwapi-count is one anonymous GET on an allowlisted read route and sends no credential. A sign-in is a POST to /dwapi/users/authenticate with the persona's user name and password, a secret no build field carries, followed by a read made as that user. Needs a delivery sign-in handler, a persona credential supplied to the runner like DW_API_TOKEN (never written to the build or report), and the authenticate route allowlisted for that handler only.
